text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky claimed the Classic Triple Crown 
in splendid fashion. The very next day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the trainer's office, 
there was a massive mountain of cardboard 
boxes piled up...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning~. Mind if I borrow a bit 
of this space?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's a sea bream (tai). Grandpa says 
it's "mede-tai" (auspicious)! So there you 
go.
choice_data_list: All of this is from your grandfather?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right~ It's quite a troublesome 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, like, I went and achieved the Triple 
Crown, right? And Grandpa was just so, 
sooo thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A fishing chair, some nice bait... He sent 
me every single thing I mentioned wanting 
a while back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Seiun Sky once told 
me that winning a Classic race was her 
grandfather's dream.
choice_data_list: What are you doing here, though?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a close one, you know? I 
woke up with this really bad feeling, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Delivery Courier
text_block_list.text:
Umm... that package is for the academy, 
right? And these over here are... all for 
the dorms!? And for the same person!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, excuse me, that luggage. Could you 
let me take a look at it?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"To Seiun Sky"... That's Grandpa. Whoa, 
what a massive amount.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm Seiun Sky, and could you send all 
of that to the Academy? The address is—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, that was a real close call!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I'd woken up any later, my room 
would've been completely buried in 
cardboard boxes.
choice_data_list:
...Are you okay with leaving the Trainer's 
room like that?

...Are you okay with leaving the Trainer's 
room like that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch as always~☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
First off, I'm just going to finish 
checking what's inside!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So with that, Trainer, you sea-riously 
wanna order the sea bream! ...Just 
kidding~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Please cook it while it's still 
fresh. Thank you so much~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, holding the sea bream, I was 
heading toward the kitchen, but... having 
forgotten to ask how they preferred it 
cooked, I turned back. That was when—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, thanks a lot. Uh-huh, yeah... yep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Grandpa, not that bamboo pole. 
It's super hard to catch anything with 
that~
choice_data_list: (Is she on the phone with her grandpa...?)

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"What're you saying?! With that, Sky can 
catch a tuna or a marlin no problem, 
right? Come on, give Grandpa a real 
surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? Geez, you're asking for the 
impossible~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then if I catch something amazing with 
that bamboo rod, will Grandpa want to 
ruffle my head?

text_block_list.name: Sky's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! I'd do it as much as you want! 
Grandpa always wants to give Sky headpats, 
you know!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, fine then. Hehe, don't blame me 
if your back gives out, Gramps!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Hey Grandpa, the other 
day, you know—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I'll let the sea bream simmer slowly. 
With that in mind, I headed to the 
kitchen.
